say:1:1030204201:1.text: Have I been found out? Are you here to yell at me?
say:1:1030204201:1.source_cn: 我——我被发现了吗？！你是来批评我的？
say:1:1030204201:1.male: Have I been found out? Are you here to yell at me?
say:1:1030204201:1.female: Have I been found out? Are you here to yell at me?

say:2:1030204202:1.text:
I confess. I brought Esther and Lowell to the grape field.
And I erected the Peace Patrol...
say:2:1030204202:1.source_cn: 我坦白，其实埃斯特和罗威尔都是我带去葡萄田的。\n和平...
say:2:1030204202:1.male:
I confess. I brought Esther and Lowell to the grape field.
And I erected the Peace Patrol...
say:2:1030204202:1.female:
I confess. I brought Esther and Lowell to the grape field.
And I erected the Peace Patrol...

say:3:1030204203:1.text: Because my pa is always too busy making money to go home...
say:3:1030204203:1.source_cn: 因为我的爸爸总是很忙，他说要去赚钱，总也不回家……
say:3:1030204203:1.male: Because my pa is always too busy making money to go home...
say:3:1030204203:1.female: Because my pa is always too busy making money to go home...

say:4:1030204204:1.text: I wanted to help him. If I can bring back some grapes, we'll be able to make a fortune.
say:4:1030204204:1.source_cn: 我也想帮帮他，只要偷拿回贵重的葡萄来，就可以换到很多钱啦！
say:4:1030204204:1.male: I wanted to help him. If I can bring back some grapes, we'll be able to make a fortune.
say:4:1030204204:1.female: I wanted to help him. If I can bring back some grapes, we'll be able to make a fortune.

say:5:1030204205:1.text: That way, he can come home and tell me stories again. Stories about Magister Merlin, and sailors, and things not from here...
say:5:1030204205:1.source_cn: 这样爸爸就会回家给我讲故事了。梅林大人的故事，水手出港...
say:5:1030204205:1.male: That way, he can come home and tell me stories again. Stories about Magister Merlin, and sailors, and things not from here...
say:5:1030204205:1.female: That way, he can come home and tell me stories again. Stories about Magister Merlin, and sailors, and things not from here...
